description: Returns one published item in full: its dates, summary, impact, migration path, replacement, affected versions and sources, as Markdown and as structured data. Use it with the slug of a row that search_items returned; the address of the item page or its short address works too. An unknown slug is answered as an error, and so is a withdrawn item, with the notice that it was withdrawn.

slug.description: Slug of the item, as in the slug field of a row. The address of the item page, of its Markdown or JSON form, or its short address is accepted too.

name: get_item

affected_versions.description: Versions affected. Array in JSON, joined with "; " in CSV.

announced_date.description: Date the vendor announced the change (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not stated.

category.description: Kind of thing affected, for example service, runtime, kubernetes or database.

cloud.description: Cloud the item belongs to: azure, aws, gcp, oci or multi.

created_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC) when the item was first published here.

effective_date.description: Date the change takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not announced. For month, quarter and year precision this is the first day of the period.

effective_precision.description: How exact effective_date is: day, month, quarter or year.

fields.description: The fields and Terraform paths the check reads, in the order of the rules.

inputs.description: The kinds of file the estate check can detect the item from.

resource_types.description: The resource types the rules of the item name, in the order of the rules.

estate_check.description: What the estate check reads to detect resources this item affects, as the item page lists it. Null when the item has no estate check rules. The check runs in the browser of the reader: no address of this site takes a file, a resource ID or a subscription ID.

extra_source_urls.description: Additional sources: official pages, or an endoflife.date page. Array in JSON, joined with "; " in CSV.

impact.description: What stops working and who is affected.

last_checked_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC) of the last successful recheck against the source.

migration_path.description: Steps to take before the effective date. May contain Markdown.

replacement.description: Recommended replacement, or null when the vendor names none.

service.description: Display name of the affected service.

short_url.description: Short address of the item page. It redirects to url.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the item. Never changes once published.

source_note.description: A note on the address of the source. Set when the id of an Azure Updates address names a day, effective_date has day precision and the two days differ. Null when this check does not apply or finds no difference.

source_url.description: Page the item was verified against: an official vendor page, or the endoflife.date page for the few products where it is the only source of the date.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences describing the change.

title.description: Short headline of the lifecycle change.

type.description: Kind of change: retirement, end_of_support or breaking_change.

updated_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC) of the last change to the item.

url.description: Page for this item on the site.

vendor_ref.description: Vendor reference for the announcement, or null.

title: Get one item
